variables.problem: A shirt costs $24. It is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price?
A train travels 180 miles in 3 hours. What is its average speed in miles per hour?
A recipe needs 3 eggs per batch. How many eggs are needed for 7 batches?
A box holds 48 pencils. If 12 are removed, how many remain?
Maya buys 4 notebooks at $3 each and 2 pens at $1.50 each. She pays with a $20 bill. How much change does she get?
A tank holds 200 litres. It is 40% full. If 30 litres are added, how many litres are in the tank?
A team played 25 games and won 60% of them. How many games did they lose?
A book has 320 pages. Ravi reads 40 pages a day for 5 days. How many pages are left?

A factory produces 240 units per day. 5% are defective and discarded. The rest are packed 12 per box. How many full boxes are produced in a day?
Sam drives 120 km at 60 km/h, then stops for 30 minutes, then drives another 90 km at 45 km/h. How many hours does the whole trip take?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost in cents?
If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes would it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets?
A lily pad patch doubles in size every day. It covers the whole lake on day 48. On what day did it cover half the lake?
A shop raises a $100 item by 10%, then discounts the new price by 10%. What is the final price in dollars?
